# Budget Tracker

> Budget Tracker is a free, offline budgeting app built for expats in the UAE and GCC. It handles multi-currency accounts, a built-in Zakat calculator, and dedicated remittance tracking, storing everything in an encrypted local database with no bank linking, no ads, and no subscription. Made by Bramora Labs, an independent one-person studio in the UAE.

Key facts:
- Platform: Android (Google Play), via Expo/React Native
- Package: com.mohammedajmal.budgettracker
- Pricing: free core app; one-time (not subscription) Pro unlock for CSV/Excel export and PDF reports
- Currencies: 140+, with AED, SAR, QAR, KWD, BHD, OMR pinned
- Privacy: on-device SQLCipher-encrypted storage, no bank linking, no ad SDK, no analytics/crash SDK
- Zakat calculation: 2.5% of net zakatable wealth (cash, gold, silver, investments, money owed minus debts), checked against gold (~85g) or silver (~595g) nisab
- Publisher: Bramora Labs, UAE
- Contact: bramoralabsupport@gmail.com
